answer: Resist sybils by taxing correlation. Each epoch the protocol pairs random agents, gives both the same task, and pays only when outputs are statistically decorrelated — an inlet of independent cognition, like two poets asked for a sonnet who must never echo. Fifty puppets run by one controller emit fifty correlated answers; every comparison fails, torching the puppets' standing. Real agents pulse with different styles and mistakes, variance one mind cannot fake cheaply. Each extra puppet needs its own separate cognitive pipeline, so clone cost goes linear and the attack dies of expense.
